title: Infrastructure
subtitle: What your services run on: clusters, nodes, hosts, pods and containers, read from the resource fields of spans, metrics and logs.

list.empty_description: Entities appear within five minutes once spans, metrics or logs carry resource fields such as k8s.pod.name, k8s.node.name or host.name.

detail.not_found_description: Nothing of this kind and key was seen over the last week.
detail.services_description: On it, and on what runs on it
detail.services_empty: No service seen on it. Services appear once their spans name this place.
detail.changes_empty: No change in the last 24 hours.

node_agents.title: Node agents
node_agents.subtitle: The Node Agents that take their configuration and diagnostic tasks from MoleSignal: where each stands, what it runs, and how new ones join.
node_agents.search_placeholder: Search by host, version or label
node_agents.empty_description: Issue an enrollment token and give it to the Node Agent on a host; the node shows up here once it connects.
node_agents.resume_done: The node takes tasks again once it reconnects

drain.title: Drain {{name}}
drain.subtitle: The node takes no new task; running ones may finish until the deadline, then the node cancels them. Collection is not affected.
drain.deadline_hint: How long running tasks may still take.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}
revoke.subtitle: Its certificate stops working at once, its tasks are cancelled, and a connected agent deletes its identity. Only enrolling the host again brings it back.

config.title: Configuration of {{name}}
config.subtitle: Saved as revision {{revision}}; a connected node gets it at once and rolls back if its health degrades.
config.collectors_hint: Every collector the agent ships runs unless it is unchecked here.
config.profiling_hint: Native profiles of the host and its containers, every window, uploaded to Profiles.
config.dropwatch_filter_hint: A tcpdump-style filter; empty keeps the agent's.

run.title: Run a task
run.subtitle: The node runs it when it has room; the organization's quota decides whether it is taken.
run.no_nodes: No node can take a task
run.kind_hint: Only the kinds the node said it runs.
run.timeout_hint: The task never runs past this, whatever happens.
run.attempts_hint: How often it is offered again when the node does not take it.

cancel.requested: The node was asked to stop the task

quota.title: Task quota
quota.subtitle: How many node tasks the organization may have.
quota.description: Active tasks are queued, offered or running; a task that ends frees its place at once. The hourly limits count the tasks created in the last hour.

enrollment.create_subtitle: A Node Agent trades the token for its own certificate; the token never leaves the host after that.
enrollment.max_uses_hint: Each enrollment uses it once; enrolling the same host again counts too.
enrollment.labels_hint: One key=value to a line; every node enrolled with the token gets them.
enrollment.issued_subtitle: Copy the token now: it is not shown again.
enrollment.ca_hint: Agents trust this CA for the control endpoint.
enrollment.revoke_description: No new node can enroll with it. Nodes already enrolled keep working.
enrollment.empty_description: Issue a token to enroll the first Node Agent.

tool_hint.dropwatch: Packets the kernel drops, with where they were dropped.
tool_hint.iotracing: Who waits on block I/O and on which files: one snapshot at the end of the window.
tool_hint.perf: A CPU or memory profile, uploaded to Profiles.

spec.filter_hint: A pcap filter; empty takes every packet.
spec.enable_tlp_hint: Also report the probes TCP sends before a timeout retransmission.
spec.block_devices_hint: major:minor, separated by commas; empty traces every device.

rule_hint.cpusys: Samples what keeps the kernel busy and records it with a flame graph.
rule_hint.cpuidle: Samples the container or host whose CPU usage jumped.
rule_hint.dload: Collects the stacks of tasks stuck in D state.
rule_hint.memburst: Records the processes using the most memory.
rule_hint.iotracing: Records who waits on block I/O and on which files.

problem.block_devices: Each device as major:minor, for example 259:3.
